## 66:4 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** All the-earth bows-down to-You and-sings-praise to-You; they-sing-praise to-Your-name.' Selah.
- **LOGOS:** All the earth worships You and sings praises to You; they sing praises to Your name.' Selah.
- **PNEUMA:** Everything on earth will worship You; they will sing Your praises, shouting Your name in glorious songs.' Pause and reflect.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
